notes.bbox: We use xywh: center coordinates and width/height - not normalized. Coordinate system has origin (0,0) at bottom-left, and top-right is (width, height).
notes.crs: We suggest using EPSG codes, either specified as an integer or 'EPSG:XXXX'. Proj string can also be used.
notes.numbers: Image dimensions, numeric IDs, ir_id and group_id are integers; numeric CRS values are integer EPSG codes.
notes.image_formats: No image-format allowlist has been supplied. image.format remains an unrestricted string until the options for E[image_formats] are defined.
notes.polygons: Optional polygon rings as lists of [x,y] pairs, in the same original-image, bottom-left coordinate system as boxes. Holes and raster RLE are not implicitly converted to polygons.
notes.category_id: Producer category ID; interpretation requires the source vocabulary. IDs are not automatically remapped between vocabularies.
notes.area: Optional source-reported area, in pixel-square units. It is not automatically recomputed from a box or contour.
notes.extra_information: Per-record and per-instance namespaced adapter fields preserve native details without making them universal IR concepts.
notes.compatibility: ir_name="ISIR" and ir_id=1 identify this data IR contract, not an individual prediction. Unknown versions must be handled explicitly.
notes.scope: One ISIR record describes detections on exactly one image. Multi-image adapters return a collection of these records; dataset-level metadata may be retained separately from the per-image records.
